source_records.claim_limit: Vocabulary/component-context anchor only. It does not provide reducer rating, coupling selection, alignment limits, lubricant selection, condition acceptance, repair authority or equipment-specific operating permission.

source_records.lane: General-purpose reducer scope / Russian technical boundary
source_records.source: ГОСТ 31592-2012 — Редукторы общемашиностроительного применения. Общие технические условия
source_records.claim_limit: General-purpose reducer scope remains valid. The statement that requirements may be used for special-purpose reducers does not prove exact applicability or authorize importing generic numeric values into an actual crane reducer. Exact model/passport/OEM/design documentation remains required for equipment-specific values.

source_records.source: ГОСТ Р 50895-2025 — Муфты зубчатые. Технические условия
source_records.claim_limit: Current scope is gear couplings of general machinery within the standard’s stated conditions. Gear-coupling torque/displacement/installation requirements must not be generalized to elastomeric, rigid/flange, disc, chain or other coupling families, nor treated as exact crane-drive applicability without identity/scope proof.

source_records.source: ISO 6336-1:2019 — Calculation of load capacity of spur and helical gears — Part 1
source_records.claim_limit: Formal experienced-gear-designer calculation framework. It is not a beginner shortcut, does not assure assembled drive-system performance, and no paid equations, factors, coefficients or numeric rating procedure are reconstructed in D1.

source_records.source: ISO 10825-1:2022 — Gears — Wear and damage to gear teeth — Part 1: Nomenclature and characteristics
source_records.claim_limit: Terminology/appearance/condition-description source only. It does not itself establish cause, prevention, acceptance, serviceability or return-to-service verdicts; specialist investigation can still be required.

source_records.source: ISO 12925-1:2024 — Lubricants, industrial oils and related products (class L) — Family C (gears) — Part 1: Specifications for lubricants for enclosed gear systems
source_records.claim_limit: Specification boundary for lubricants used in enclosed gear systems. It does not select the actual grade, viscosity, compatibility, fill quantity, interval or substitution for a specific crane reducer without OEM/equipment requirements.

source_records.source: ISO 14691:2008 — Petroleum, petrochemical and natural gas industries — Flexible couplings for mechanical power transmission — General-purpose applications
source_records.claim_limit: Its general-purpose applications are explicitly inside petroleum/petrochemical/natural-gas industries. It remains a mechanism/terminology companion only and is not promoted to crane-specific coupling selection, alignment, displacement, inspection, acceptance or operation authority. It also does not define criteria for selecting coupling types for specific applications.

source_records.lane: Russian regulatory / operation / repair authority boundary
source_records.claim_limit: Current regulatory/safe-operation/repair/technical-examination authority lane. It does not substitute reducer/coupling design standards, actual passport/OEM data, gear rating methods or component-specific numeric acceptance limits. Equipment launch/operation authority remains with the legally/documentarily designated process and responsible persons.

source_records.source: Passport / OEM / drawings / operating documentation for the actual crane drive, reducer and coupling
source_records.claim_limit: Exact equipment identity, drawing/manual revision and configuration must be demonstrated. This lane governs actual reducer/coupling model data, permitted torque/speed/displacement, alignment, lubricant, maintenance, inspection/acceptance and equipment-specific instructions where applicable; absence is a legitimate STOP / REQUEST EXACT DATA condition.

watchlist.reason: The standard is current/confirmed, but its industry scope is petroleum, petrochemical and natural gas. D1 has no need to promote it into crane-specific normative authority.
watchlist.action: RETAIN AS DEVELOPMENT COMPANION ONLY. Recheck identity/status before any future source-bound use and prefer a directly applicable crane/general-machinery source for any future normative coupling claim.
